items.text:
Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Been talking to some awesome people about a few roles in this show from my recent posts, and will be making final decisions fairly soon here! If you're interested in auditioning, or hearing more about any of the main or supporting roles, feel free to shoot us an email - thanks, all! 

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

**CASTING CALL - NEW SHOW AT WYNN LAS VEGAS!** 

**Wynn Las Vegas is seeking trained male and female dancers, aerialists with dance skills, and dancers with aerial experience** 

**Contracts begin February 2027**

**OPEN CALLS - NO PRE-REGISTRATION REQUIRED**

**NORTH HOLLYWOOD, CA**
Friday, October 23, 2026
Mihran K. NoHo
5437 Satsuma Avenue

North Hollywood, CA 91601

**LAS VEGAS / HENDERSON, NV**
Saturday, October 24, 2026
The Stage
2510 Anthem Village Drive, #150

Henderson, NV 89052

**AUDITION SCHEDULE - BOTH LOCATIONS**
* **Men:** 10:00 AM (sign-in begins at 9:30 AM)
* **Women:** 1:30 PM (sign-in begins at 1:00 PM)

**CALLBACKS:** Sunday, October 25, 2026, in Las Vegas

**WHAT TO BRING & WEAR**
• Resume and headshot
• Sneakers or flat dance shoes
• Form-fitting clothing that clearly shows your body lines and silhouette. Please avoid baggy clothing.

**IMPORTANT INFORMATION**
• All performers, including aerialists, must participate in the initial movement/dance audition.
• Aerial evaluations will take place separately at another location and date.
• All applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.
• Must be 21 years of age or older to audition.
• This is a non-union production.

items.text:
**WARSZAWA**

**29 października**

**Film fabularny – DUBLERKA 70+**

**Stawka 1500 zł**

Do nowego filmu fabularnego, do którego zdjęcia ruszają pod koniec października, **poszukujemy dublerki aktorki (wiek 70+)**. Szukamy pani o wzroście ok. 168 cm i rozmiarze ubrań **L./XL** 

Talia 100 Biodra 118 Waga 75 Biust 120-130

Specyfika sceny wymaga pełnej nagości, przy czym ujęcia będą realizowane bez pokazywania wizerunku (twarzy).

Więcej szczegółów przekażę w odpowiedzi na zgłoszenie wybranym paniom. 

Zgłoszenia poproszę na adres: **jarek.drzycimski@podtytulem.pl**

W tytule: **DUBLERKA 29 **

W treści: imię i nazwisko, wiek, nr telefonu, miejscowość

W załączniku: **aktualne** **zdjęcie twarzy (selfie najlepiej) i koniecznie aktualne zdjęcie sylwetki (oczywiście w ubraniu).**

**ZDJĘCIE TWARZY** - portretowe selfie w dziennym świetle, na wprost, patrząc w obiektyw. Bez żadnych filtrów. Bez okularów. Bez nakrycia głowy. Kolorowe.

**ZDJĘCIE SYLWETKI** – aktualne, cała sylwetka

🎬 CASTING CALL — FEMALE LEAD FOR MUSIC VIDEO
📍 Location: Warsaw, Poland

Dates: 19.10-22.10 (estimate) 

Mystique Studios is casting a female lead, age 26–30, for an upcoming music video production to be filmed in Warsaw, Poland.

We are looking for a woman with:

• East European look

• Natural, innocent features

• Expressive face and comfortable presence in front of the camera

• Acting/modeling experience is welcome, but not essential

• Ability to portray natural emotion, warmth and chemistry on camera

🎥 ABOUT THE PROJECT

The music album has already been released, and we are now producing an official music video intended for YouTube, social media promotion and submission to music video/film festivals.

The shoot will take approximately 1–2 days in Warsaw, Poland.

This is an independent, low-budget production, so please apply with this in mind.

💰 COMPENSATION

This is a paid role, with cash payment depending on the selected cast member, experience and final shooting requirements.

Food, snacks and drinks will be provided during filming.

🎞️ ABOUT US

We are an independent, low-budget production studio focused on films, music and visual storytelling.

Our work includes:

• 2 completed feature films produced for the festival festivals 

• One feature officially selected at 30+ film festivals across Europe and winner of 10+ awards

• 2 released music videos

• 10+ released music albums

• Several new film, music and visual projects currently in development

📩 TO APPLY

Please send:

• Your name and age

• Prefer location - Warsaw 

• 3–5 recent photographs — preferably portrait and full-length

• Links to Instagram or other social media

• Acting/modeling/showreel links, if available

• Brief details of previous experience, if any

WhatsApp: +48 579 162 415

Email: mystiquestudios@yahoo.com

Telegram: @Mystiquestudios

Please write “MUSIC VIDEO CASTING” when contacting us.

Selected applicants may be invited for a short meeting or camera test in Warsaw before final casting.

🎬 Mystique Studios

Independent Film • Music • Visual Storytelling

**PAID CASTING CALL**

**MIAMI CHARACTERS WANTED!**

**We're casting 5 larger-than-life Miami-inspired personalities for an exciting gaming-inspired commercial production.**

You'll interact with contestants as part of a fun on-camera challenge, where they must work out who really knows Miami and who might be bluffing.

**WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

**REAL MIAMI LOCALS LIVING IN LONDON**
* Originally from Miami, Florida.
* Authentic knowledge and personal experience of the city.

**& CONVINCING MIAMI CHARACTERS**
* Actors or confident performers who can convincingly portray someone from Miami.
* Believable accents, personality and improvisation skills.
* Comfortable answering questions while staying in character.

To apply [hello@talentcasting.co.uk](mailto:hello@talentcasting.co.uk) with

·       Age

·       Recent photographs

·       A short introduction video ideally demonstrating your accent or character work.

CASTING CALL!

**One Fork, 90 Seconds Comedy Short**
UWE Student Film - BRISTOL - Nov 2026

*An office descends into chaos when lunchtime arrives and there's only one fork left in the drawer.*

Looking for three office worker actors:

CHRIS: 30 - 50 YEARS OLD - A gym bro, preferably tall.

He thinks he deserves everything; very egotistical.

LILLY: 20 - 60 YEARS OLD - Preferably smaller than Chris.

She's so tired of being stuck in her job, but she wants a promotion as she's worked there for so long.

ALEX: 20 - 29 YEARS OLD - Any gender identity, person of colour. Has had to fight to get the job they have now and isn't going to lose it. Smarter than the other two.

1 Different Locations in Bristol.

2 Shooting Days

TBC - Between 11 and 22 November.

**Voluntary collaboration on a student short film.**

Contact:
**Louisa2.Spence@live.uwe.ac.uk**

**parsifal2.Elviro@live.uwe.ac.uk**

items.text:
Casting Call for Upcoming Dark-Comedy Musical 'Psychopomp!'

Been talking to some awesome people about a few roles in this show from my recent posts, and will be making final decisions fairly soon here! If you're interested in auditioning, or hearing more about any of the main or supporting roles, feel free to shoot us an email - thanks, all! 

Overview:

Psychopomp! is a new dark-comedy stage musical about the insane lengths that a couple will go to be together. The play is packed with infectious rock and roll, raucous comedy, and bombastic characters - think Beetlejuice meets Alice Cooper. The word 'Psychopomp' refers to the being that brings one's spirit into the afterlife, like Anubis, the Valkyries, Charon on the River Styx, or The Grim Reaper. As the settings and humor of the show dissolve into madness, the play morphs from Romeo and Juliet, to Rocky Horror, to The Addams Family, on an irreverent ride through the afterlife.

General Info:

Performance Location: Upstairs at El Centro in Hollywood, CA

Performance Dates: February 26th, 27th, and 28th (evenings)

Rehearsal Location: TBD dependent upon cast-member locations (first few rehearsals likely in San Fernando)

Rehearsal Dates: Starting Winter of 2026/2027 – time TBD

Union Affiliation: Non-union

Contact info: Justin - psychopomprocks@gmail.com

Compensation: Dependent on role – profits from the show will be paid to cast. On longer rehearsal nights, meals will be provided. The show will be filmed and photographed, and a cast album will be recorded – all available for you to use however you like.

Requested Audition Materials:

-Self tape of a scene/monologue and/or video of previous stage or film work

-Self tape or live video of vocal music performance – rock/pop preferred

ROLES:

TESS – Female - 25-38

Fun, sarcastic punk rock guitarist – Confident, but doesn't take herself too seriously. Guitar experience a plus, but not at all required.

VIKKI – Female - 25-38

Tess' friend – think Rizzo from Grease. Sassy but protective of Tess. And sometimes a little annoyed by her, too.

JAKE – Male - 25-38

Sincere, self-effacing, sorta nerdy - aspiring magician.

LUKE – Male - 25-38

Jake's friend – laid-back, smooth, funny, etc - Cooler than Jake, but that's a low bar.

GUITARIST and DRUMMER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The actual live musicians for the show – upstage throughout show.

GRIM REAPER – Male/Female – no age requirement

The Psychopomp. Tess' sidekick throught the play. Not overly ambitious about their career.

PSYCHIC – Male/Female – no age requirement

Charlatan in a world where all the weird, wild mythology turns out to be real.

MAD SCIENTIST – Male/Female – no age requirement

Beach-bum parrot-head scientist – eccentric but earnest.

OTHER ONE-SCENE ROLES:

COP, BARTENDER, BAND SINGER, CAPTAIN HOOK, CRUELLA DE VIL, CHARLIE CHAPLIN, HELL RECEPTIONIST, HERCULES, 007, AWARD SHOW HOST, HEAVEN SHOWRUNNER – Male/Female based on the character – no age requirement.

NOTE: For most of these roles, the actor will play multiple roles (for example, the person playing VIKKI could also play the CRUELLA).

Feel free to send an email with any questions on the audition process, or any other info you would like!

If you would like to audition for a specific singing role, let me know, and I can send you demos of that character's songs.

Thanks, all! Looking forward to hearing from you!

Wir sind HS-Systeme, ein deutscher Hersteller unter der Marke Magic Motion, und suchen eine sympathische, volljährige Darstellerin für drei kurze Videoaufnahmen.

Die Videos können bequem zu Hause mit einem guten Smartphone aufgenommen werden.

Do niezależnego filmu krótkometrażowego **„Burza”** poszukujemy aktora do roli drugoplanowej (support).

**POSZUKIWANY AKTOR:**
* Mężczyzna w wieku 60+
* Przeciętny wzrost, krępa budowa ciała / nadwaga
* Naturalność i wiarygodność przed kamerą

**O ROLI**

Józek – starszy pan, sąsiad głównego bohatera. Rola wymaga przede wszystkim umiejętności wiarygodnego oddania przerażenia.

Nie wymagamy profesjonalnego doświadczenia aktorskiego – liczy się przede wszystkim talent i naturalność.

**INFORMACJE O PRODUKCJI**
* 🎥 Projekt: niezależny film krótkometrażowy, horror sci-fi
* 📍 Miejsce zdjęć: Warszawa
* 📅 Termin: ostatni weekend listopada 2026
* ⏱️ Plan zdjęciowy: 3 dni
* 💰 Udział: nieodpłatny, produkcja non profit
* 🍽️ Zapewniamy wyżywienie i dojazd na plan.

Zainteresowane osoby prosimy o przesłanie showreela lub krótkiego filmiku prezentującego swoje możliwości aktorskie na adres:

📩 biuro@wielkipost.com

Casting odbędzie się zarówno zdalnie, jak i stacjonarnie.

Zapraszamy do współpracy! 🎬

🎬 CZEŚĆ WARSZAWO! SZUKAM IMPREZOWICZÓW! 🎉
Na plan reklamy jednej z platform sprzedażowych szukam statystów w wieku 17–25 lat do roli imprezowiczów.

Osoby powyżej 20. roku życia muszą wyglądać na maksymalnie 20 lat.

📅 Zdjęcia: 25.10 lub 26.10

To nie jest kontynuacja — w zgłoszeniu podajcie datę lub obie daty, w których jesteście dostępni.

⏰ Godziny nie są jeszcze znane, a plan może rozpocząć się wcześnie rano. Wymagana pełna dyspozycyjność w zgłaszanym dniu.

💰 Stawka: 140 zł, płatne przelewem.

W przypadku wykorzystania wizerunku przewidziana jest dopłata.

📲 Zgłoszenia wysyłajcie na numer: 797 169 069

Z dopiskiem „IMPREZOWICZ + data”.

W zgłoszeniu proszę zawrzeć:

• imię i nazwisko,

• wiek,

• wyraźne zdjęcia twarzy i sylwetki.

❗ Pod uwagę będą brane tylko kompletne zgłoszenia.

📩 Na zgłoszenia czekam do 22.10 do godz. 19:00.

Do wybranych osób odezwę się do końca dnia 23.10.

Marta 🎬 Filmakcja

Dobrego dnia! 😀

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

**Updated Casting and Crew Call for Don't Go Yet. Extras, remaining speaking roles, voice actors and crew needed!**

Please see attached previous post for questions on anything not included in this update. 

**Updates**

Dates and Locations – November 7th and 8th in Wheat Ridge. November 14th and 15th in Westminster.

**Crew Call**

Production Assistant 

Camera PA/2nd AC

Reach out to [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with any questions.

**Extras!**

Dates and Location – We need around 10 – 15 extras for the weekend of November 14th and 15th in Westminster.

Description - Ages 25 – 38, any race, any gender for what will be a house party scene along with a crowd reacting to a garage band perform.

Contact – Please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) if interested!

Compensation – All extras will be fed snacks and meals on the days they are present.

**Supporting Roles Not Cast Yet **

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Katie – Supporting – Late 20’s to early 30s (any race) – Adam’s on again off again girlfriend. Promiscuous and likes to have a good time when it comes to partying. Her and Adam have a complicated relationship but once Adam puts his famous charm on, she runs back every time.

Compensation – All roles will be fed snacks and meals on the days they are present along with credit on the film.  

**Bit ****Parts**

Female Child – 8 to 11 years old (any race) – Need a child to play a girl scout with one line of dialogue. This part will equate to around 1-2 hours of work.

Mother of girl scout – 35 – 45 years old (same race as child) – Mother of girl scout. This part will equate to around 1-2 hours of work.

**Voiceover Roles**

Matt – 20 – 30 years old (any race) – Connor’s coworker that calls him over the phone regarding a work issue.

Rebecca – 30 -40 years old (any race) – Connor’s manager that joins the phone call regarding work issue.

Comedian on Podcast – 30 – 50 years old (any race) – Comedian is played over a speaker riffing on Huntingtons disease.

**Casting Call - Don't Go Yet **

Logline/Genre - Don’t Go Yet is a short film and passion project of mine. It is a dark dramedy focused on a pair of best friends Adam and Connor. When Adam walks in on a failed suicide attempt by Connor, he persuades him to give twenty-four hours to convince him life is worth living. If he fails, Connor may go through with the suicide with no interruption.

Dates and Locations – Dates have been nailed down but we are aiming for two to three weekends of shooting at the end of October/beginning of November. Locations are close to being locked in with one in Wheat Ridge and the other in Westminster.

Director – Cody Pape

Director of Photography – Alex Sistare

Compensation – The two leads will be paid $150 - $200 a day. Rest of the cast will be unpaid. Snacks and meals will be provided on all shoot days. You’ll also receive credit for the film.

Union Status – Non-union

Audition information - If interested please email [ctpape19@gmail.com](mailto:ctpape19@gmail.com) with the subject line “Don’t Go Yet – Your Name” with head shots, reels and any other applicable material and I will send sides in response. Once we have dates locked, we plan to hold in-person auditions for the two leads and most of the supporting cast.

Project Notes –** **Please note that this project contains heavy drug use and acts of suicide and self-harm.

**Characters**

Connor – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A scrawny, handsome but unkept male that has lost all excitement about life. A small number of tattoos is preferred but not a requirement. He was once a very loving, outgoing person loved by many before everyone around him started to grow up. He refuses to make changes in his life due to the effort required to make them. Contact with close friends has depleted and he hasn’t been on a date in years. The only consistent thing in his life that brings him genuine joy is his best friend, Adam. He’s not miserable but he’s not happy. He’s done with the monotony of existing.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging, plastic bag over the head and prat falls are included in this role.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Adam – Lead – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) - Adam is an average height; muscular man covered in tattoos with a smile they would use in a toothpaste advertisement. It's not mentioned that he is ex-military, but his appearance would suggest he served. He has a handful of extremely close relationships with men in his life but dates a new woman every month. He is the epitome of toxic masculinity and has no idea how to express himself. All feelings and emotions are under lock and key except when it comes to Connor who has access at times.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Stunt work is required for this role. Suicide attempt by hanging.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Alec – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – College buddy of Connor’s. Smaller in size. Timid and has trouble sticking up for himself. Is always in the circle but has trouble getting a word in.

Amanda – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – A mutual friend of Adam and Connor’s. What once was an extremely important platonic friendship for Connor who could come to Amanda with any problem and get the support needed has become something distant to the point that Amanda has given up on the friendship. She is energetic, bubbly and can be a little bit of a steamroller in conversation. She finds it easy to give relationship advice but can’t figure out why she hasn’t found Mr. Right yet.

Gabe – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male or female (any race) – Connor and Adam’s old guitar player in a band that was taking off before Connor decided to self-sabotage the success. Gabe doesn’t hold any resentment. He lives in the moment at all times and couldn’t bother himself with what happened yesterday or the events of tomorrow.

Preferred skills:
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Greg – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – A high school friend of Connor and Adam’s. The starting quarterback that had all eyes on him on and off the field has had trouble accepting that time of his life is no longer around. He doesn’t have a lot going on upstairs. He assumed his body would take him places until laziness and beer took that from him. He is large and in charge in conversation and physical appearance. He picks on those smaller than him, projecting his own pain but is also quite oblivious to anyone’s feelings but his own.

Hailey – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s female (any race) – Connor’s ex-girlfriend. To Connor, Hailey is the one that got away. They’re not together for many reasons but when they look at each other, there is an unspoken agreement that they will try again at some point. Hailey is the struggling artist that has it all figured out on the outside but due to past trauma can’t seem to give herself over to anyone once it becomes serious. Indie, alternative, mildly goth aesthetic. Piercings and tattoos are encouraged.

Tim – Supporting – late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Amanda’s new boyfriend that give’s Connor some perspective on life. Tim is a counterweight to Amanda’s energy and appears to be the answer to her prayers. You can tell they’re madly in love by the synchronicity of their laughter.

Vinny – Supporting - late 20’s to early 30s male (any race) – Singer or Guitar player of Adam and Connor’s old band. He was also Connor’s closest friend aside from Adam. He’s gone on with the band’s name with new members and is seeing the success that Connor always dreamed of. Both Connor and Vinny hold resentment towards each other. Vinny see’s Connor as wasted potential while Connor sees him as a sellout.

Preferred skills
* Experience with instruments, specifically drums and/or guitar.
* Knowledge of hardcore and heavier music.

Look forward to hearing from you!

Casting two 13-15 year old male/female actors for short film. 

Title: "The Commie"

A short comedy about a middling actor who forces his family to commit to his method style of performance after being cast as the lead in a community theater production of “Oliver Twist.”

Ability to play annoyed siblings who find solace in one another as they begrudgingly participate in their father’s method actor style of character preparation.

Company: MccDrew, LLC

Shoot Dates: Sat Nov. 21st – Sun. Nov. 22nd. 

Pay: $150/day

Send headshot and a 1-2 min. comedic monologue to: [wctreat@gmail.com](mailto:wctreat@gmail.com)

Calling all filmmakers! The 2027 edition has just launched - and we want to see YOUR short films!

Now in their 5th year, the free-to-enter Awards are bigger than ever. This year, we introduced a brand new Immersive category, presented by Meta, celebrating how immersive formats expand the way we experience storytelling.

The filmmakers behind 34 shortlisted films will be flown to Los Angeles to attend a four-day industry program on the Sony Pictures Studios lot to help elevate their careers. You will learn from Sony Pictures executives through workshops, masterclasses, panel discussions, screenings, demos, tours and Q&As.

The week ends with a bang at a red carpet Awards ceremony, a perfect opportunity to network with fellow filmmakers and industry experts.

The six categories are:
• Fiction
• Non-Fiction
• Animation
🆕 Immersive
• Student
• Future Format

Why enter? 

✈️ Be flown to Los Angeles for an exclusive industry program (flights + accommodation included)
✍️ Gain unparalleled access to the inner workings of the industry through sessions and masterclasses led by Sony Pictures executives
🎩 Celebrate your success and network with fellow creatives at the Awards night on the Sony Pictures Studios lot
🎥 Winners receive a range of prizes depending on their category, including Sony camera equipment, a Meta VR device, and cash prizes. 

🆕Also new this year: The Snapdragon Shorts Award. Five filmmakers, selected from the 2027 shortlist, will be given an array of Snapdragon powered devices and equipment including a smartphone and laptop to create an original short film. The winner receives an all-expenses-paid trip to Hawaii for an official announcement and film premiere at the Snapdragon Summit and exposure to millions through the Snapdragon Insiders community.

Take the next exciting step in your filmmaking career, widen your professional network and gain insight from people who have shaped the industry today.

🔗 Enter your short film for free now! Link in bio.

@sonypictures @metaquest

#SFFA2027 #sonyfuturefilmmakerawards

Hi everyone! 👋🏽

My name is Anyssa, a professional model based in Wolverhampton, West Midlands.

I previously worked as a model in my home country and have experience in runway modelling and photoshoots. I’m looking to establish myself further in the UK industry by connecting and collaborating with talented local creatives.

Open to collaborations (TFP / Commercial) with:

*Photographers

*Makeup Artists & Hair Stylists

*Wardrobe Stylists & Brands

*Fellow Models

Genres: High Fashion / Runway • Streetwear & Editorial • Fitness & Activewear

Model Specs & Info:

*Location: Wolverhampton (Open to West Midlands & surrounding areas)

*Height: 1m80 (5'11")

*Dress Size: UK 8–10

*Instagram: @anyssa_manuela

If you’d like to collaborate or bounce some creative ideas around, drop a comment or send me a DM! Let’s build something amazing together. 📸✨

Hello everyone! 😊

I’m wondering if anyone knows of any singing opportunities for a young soprano aged 15 (almost 16). She’s interested in exploring different styles of music, including classical, opera, musical theatre, pop, or anything else that might be a good fit.

Any recommendations or advice would be greatly appreciated.  Thanks

topComments.text: Where are you based? Contact your local Music Hub as they will have singing groups

best thing my daughter did from a young age was join our local musical theatre group for experiences.  she’s now at college doing a performing arts course and is planning on uni hopefully next year! hope you manage to find something for her x

items.text:
I’m interested in getting my dogs into the industry, any tips on where to start? 

They are both highly trained, and comfortable working at a distance/in a wide variety of settings. 
The black spaniel x is a working assistance dog and competes in agility. Knows lots of tricks/behaviours. But obviously is black so not ideal for cameras!! She is used to a wide variety of environments through working as an assistance dog. 

The merle collie cross is my baby dog, 18 months and is looking for a new career after her agility career is looking likely to not be feasible, she is very unique looking and knows many tricks/behaviours. She is also incredibly smart and picks things up easily.  Loves being the centre of attention! 

They are both comfortable in busy/loud environments.

topComments.text: The Animal Talent agency are fab . Speak to Paula x x

Mon 4th to Fri 15th Jan 27 | 9am - 6pm

Mon 18th to Sat 23rd Jan 27 | 9am to 5pm

URGENT CASTING CALL for Production 2 of The Black Widows Pilot
3-day film shoot on the 15th-17th November 2026 in Coventry/Rugby

We have a micro budget so will provide lunch and cover travel expenses

 

Our current cast includes makeup-artists, director of photography, 1st assistant director and script supervisor alongside our cast of actors and actresses.

 

We have the main cast recruited but have some additional exciting roles available

 

We are searching for some talented actresses and actors to bring some of these compelling characters to life on our BLACK WIDOWS production. 

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

3. VIVIAN (One scene – Half a day)

* Demographic: Black or Mixed-Race Woman, 50s to Early 60s.

* The Role: Vivian is a hardened, razor-sharp, and deeply complex woman. A recovering alcoholic, she holds the heaviest title in the room: she is the mother of Brenda James, the notorious, ruthless "mother of the underworld." 

* The Vibe: Vivian is hateful, resentful, brilliant, and fiercely intelligent. She is a multi-layered powerhouse who commands every single scene she is in. If you love playing complex, unapologetic characters with dark depths and sharp edges, Vivian is the role for you.

4. BEN (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 30s Male.

* The Character: A low level street runner who is a known criminal

5. MARCUS (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 40s-50s Male.

* The Character: A local unstable sleazeball who hustles and does whatever it takes to get on in life

6. Claire (One scene 2-3 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race (Age flexible female)

* The Character: A kind and friendly support worker who works at the drug and substance misuse clinic

EXTRA’s roles are available in addition to the above roles 

BENEFITS OF BEING PART OF THE PRODUCTION

* Official IMDb Credit: Boost your industry profile with a major television credit.

* CV & Acting Portfolio Development: Work alongside top-tier talent and crew, capturing stellar footage and high-end broadcast-quality material for your showreel post the production’s release.

* This production comes with a potential opportunity to reprise your role in a massive, upcoming 14-part TV series extension subject to investment funding! 

Please DM me for further details and to apply for the roles.

🎥 **Filming is scheduled for 2027 in the Stuttgart area of Germany.**

We are currently seeking:
* 🎬 **Actors & Actresses** — Paid opportunities
* ⭐ **Featured Extras** — Paid opportunities
* 📸 **Models** — Paid opportunities
* 🤝 **Early Contributors** — Exclusive perks and opportunities to receive Producer and Special Thanks credits

💡 **Interested in supporting the production?** An official Indiegogo campaign with exclusive perks is coming soon!

📩 **HOW TO APPLY**

Interested in joining the cast, participating in the production, or learning more about early contribution opportunities?

CASTING CALL — PICTURE PERFECT 
Independent Romantic Drama | Non-Union | Potential festival submission. 

A successful photographer dreams of building a family. A driven executive has built her life around independence. When they fall in love, their fears threaten the future they could share.

Filming in Chicago, Illinois
Projected filming: Early spring 2027
Leads: $400/day | Supporting: $300/day | Day-player $250/day
Travel and lodging covered
Submit by December 1, 2026

LEAD ROLES

ISAIAH —  African American Male, must portray ages 30–40.
A successful photographer with warmth, natural charm, and a deep desire for lasting love. Requires romantic chemistry and emotional range.

NAOMI — African American Female, must portray ages 30–40.
An accomplished executive whose professional confidence conceals a fear of emotional dependence. Requires strength, vulnerability, and natural romantic chemistry.

SUPPORTING ROLES
Ages listed are playing ranges.

• ROBERT — African American Male, late 50s–60s. Isaiah’s affectionate, quietly humorous father. A widower with a rich inner life and a powerful emotional scene.

• VIVIAN — African American Female, late 50s–60s. Naomi’s polished, protective mother, rediscovering herself after an unhappy marriage.

• LEAH — African American Female, late 20s–early 30s. A sweet, personable grocery-store employee with a shy, playful side.

• MONICA — African American Female, late 20s–mid 30s. Seeking answers after being ghosted. A small role requiring emotional depth and believable vulnerability.

• TASHA — African American Female, late 20s–early 30s. Bold, flirtatious, and playful.

• ALICIA — Latina  Female, early–mid 30s. Navigating a complicated breakup, with warmth and vulnerability beneath her frustration.

• MAYA — Female, adult. Isaiah’s capable studio assistant. Observant, supportive, and naturally funny.

• ELLIS — Adult, any gender. Naomi’s efficient assistant. Professional presence with understated humor.

INTIMACY NOTES
Lead roles involve kissing and implied intimacy. Supporting roles involving intimacy require implied intimacy only—no kissing. Requirements will be discussed before casting.

TO SUBMIT
picperfect2027@gmail.com

Subject: PICTURE PERFECT — [ROLE] — [YOUR NAME]

Include:

• Headshot and recent photo
• Acting résumé
• Reel or performance clip, if available
• Current city and contact information
• Spring 2027 availability
• Role(s) you’re submitting for

Additional background and brief speaking opportunities will be announced separately.

Share with an actor who would be a great fit!

#PicturePerfectFilm #CastingCall #ChicagoActors #ActorsWanted #PaidCasting #IndependentFilm #NonUnion

items.text:
CASTING CALL — AM I BEAUTIFUL?
Independent Supernatural Horror Feature

Some questions should never be answered.

When an antique mirror connects a university classroom to a disturbing Japanese legend, a cultural anthropology professor searches for answers as people around her begin dying.

ROLES AVAILABLE
Ages listed are playing ages.

MAYA BENNETT — Woman, 35–45
An intelligent, compassionate anthropology professor whose determination to protect her students becomes an obsession.

AIKO MORITA / THE WOMAN — Japanese woman, 28–40
A tragic woman behind a terrifying supernatural presence. Requires emotional range, expressive eyes, and strong physical storytelling. Prosthetic makeup and choreographed violence involved.

LENA ORTIZ — Woman, 20–25
A perceptive, outspoken student whose confidence is tested by grief and escalating supernatural encounters.

EMI SATO — Japanese woman, 35–50
A warm, practical language lecturer and Maya’s close friend. Dryly funny and fiercely dependable.

NICOLE BENNETT — Woman, 38–48
Maya’s loving, direct sister, struggling to keep her connected to her family.

OWEN PRICE — Man, 20–25
A charming, sarcastic student whose ordinary night becomes a terrifying fight for survival.

MARCUS REED — Man, 21–26
Owen’s easygoing close friend. Requires humor, emotional vulnerability, and intense fear.

TESSA — Woman, 20–25
A curious student who shares fragments of a disturbing legend before its consequences become personal.

DANIEL HART — Man, 40–50
A meticulous, quietly humorous university collections manager. Includes a sustained physical horror sequence.

LUIS VEGA — Man, 45–60
An experienced campus security officer with dry humor and a strong protective instinct.

NOAH WELLS — Man, 21–27
A student and campus employee caught in a terrifying encounter after his shift. Requires physical suspense and simulated injury effects.

CALEB TURNER — Man, 20–26
A student working at the recreation center whose closing routine becomes a fight for survival.

KENJI — Japanese man, 30–45
Aiko’s jealous, controlling husband. Requires restrained menace and choreographed dramatic violence.

YUMI — Japanese woman, 23–33
Aiko’s affectionate younger sister. Requires warmth, underlying concern, and a powerful grief reaction.

NAOKO — Japanese woman, 60–75
A dignified, direct woman determined to protect the truth about her family’s history.

DETECTIVE ALVAREZ — Man, 35–55
A calm, compassionate investigator who remains skeptical of extraordinary explanations.

DEPARTMENT CHAIR — Woman, 45–65
An authoritative university administrator balancing professional responsibilities with concern for her colleagues and students.

JESS — Woman, 20–25
Lena’s caring, practical roommate. Requires natural dialogue and believable friendship chemistry.

PRODUCTION DETAILS

Location: TBD — Houston, TX or Atlanta, GA
Projected filming: Spring 2027
Non-union
Lead roles: $400/day
Supporting roles: $300/day
Submission deadline: December 1, 2026

Seeking a diverse cast. All performers must be 18 or older. Roles without a specified ethnicity are open to all ethnicities.

Japanese-speaking ability is a plus, but NOT a requirement. Select roles include Japanese dialogue.

This film includes supernatural horror, simulated blood, prosthetic makeup, and choreographed violence. Certain roles involve domestic violence and suicide themes. Role-specific requirements will be discussed during casting.

TO SUBMIT

Email amibeautiful2027@gmail.com with:

• Name and role(s) of interest
• Current headshot
• Acting résumé or experience summary
• Reel or acting sample, if available
• Home city and spring 2027 availability
• Ability to work in Houston, Atlanta, or either location
• Japanese-language proficiency, if applicable

No dance experience or special skills needed—just be open to trying some simple, choreographed movement and bringing your presence. The scenes will be carefully staged, with movement and boundaries discussed together in advance.

Filming in Copenhagen, 16–17 November. Interested? DM me and I’ll send you the details ❤️

Do listopadowego odcinka 2. sezonu fabularnego serialu „Gliniarze Śląsk” realizowanego na śląsku poszukuję aktorów do nastepujących ról:

Nożyk (37) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Lassota (39) – krępy, dobrze zbudowany bandzior o groźnej aparycji. – prawo jazdy
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 600 zł netto

Ozimski (37) – przystojny biznesmen, chłodny w obyciu, patrzący na wszystkich z góry. Niemiły, nieprzyjemny w rozmowie. 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 3 tys. zł netto za całość

Zawiślak (41) – wyszczekany prywatny detektyw, modny, przystojny, robiący wokół siebie dużo hałasu 
Data: 03.11, 05.11 i 06.11
Stawka: 2400 zł netoo za całość

Wąsik (26) – przeciętny facet, przeciętna aparycja i sylwetka – prawo jazdy kat. A i B
Data: 03.11 i 05.11
Stawka: 1600 zł netto z acałość

Czernik (42) – biznesmen, zadbany, bogaty, dyrektor prywatnej kliniki chirurgii plastycznej, samotny ojciec 
Data: 03.11
Stawka: 800 zł netto

Chętnych panów zapraszam do wysyłania zgłoszeń na adres: Rita.mascarat@wp.pl

Proszę o zgłoszenia TYLKO mailowe (nie odpowiadam na wiadomości prywatne)

W tytule maila prosze o podanie nazwy postaci.

W treści maila proszę o zawarcie następujących informacji:
1. Wiek/wzrost/waga
2. Nr tel. do kontaktu
3. Linki do sowich materiałów video – demo/wizytówka/scenki castingowe (w przypadku braku, do wybranych osób wyślę materiał ze scenariusza do nagrania)
4. Aktualne zdjęcie
5. Krótki opis doświadczenia
6. Informacje o ukończonych szkołach/kursach/warsztatach aktorskich
7. Informację o posiadanym i czynnym prawie jazdy lub jego braku
8. Miejscowość zamieszkania 

Nie zwracamy kosztów dojazdu/noclegu

CASTING CALL: On-Camera Talent (Vancouver)

Your Story is casting talent for a premium training video series, shot on a curved LED wall.

1. Lead Presenter (female)

Continuity host / trainer. Straight to camera, teleprompter, polished and confident. Think MasterClass energy, not corporate video. Early 30s. Professional. Strong voice. Comfortable teaching and holding the frame.

Rate: $700/day · 2 full shoot days · includes buyout in perpetuity

2. Talk Show Co-Host (male)

Seated interview / talk-show style. Warm, sharp, natural chemistry with a co-host.

Rate: $500/day · 1 shoot day · includes buyout in perpetuity

3. Demo / Roleplay Talent (male and female)

Short on-camera demos and roleplay beats (stronger vs weaker delivery, auction-floor moments). Clear, grounded, easy to direct.

Rate: $350 half-day · includes buyout in perpetuity

Shoot: November 9 and 10, 2026

Location: Metro Vancouver

To apply, email casting@your-story.agency with a headshot, a short reel or self-tape, and which role(s) you're applying for.

items.text:
**JOHNSON PARANORMAL**

**Casting Call**

**Casting Director **– C. Patricio 

**Producers **– Ian David Nsenga, Maritama Carlson, Jeff Schellenberg

**Director **– Jeff Schellenberg

**Shoot Dates** - Nov. 19-22, 2026

**Compensation **- $200/Day

**Filming Locations** – New Westminster & Maple Ridge, B.C.

**Union Status **- Open to UBCP Union and Non-Union Performers

 

**Synopsis **– An edgy, laugh-out-loud, horror-comedy web-series about three half-brothers who open a ghost hunting start-up out of their aunt’s garage. Each episode brings a procedural-esque investigation as the crew tackles a wild new supernatural mystery.

**Tone**: Ghostbusters meets Always Sunny in Philadelphia. 

 

**CHARACTERS**

 

**FRED**** **Lead (30s/male) Fred is effortlessly handsome, incredibly chill, and a natural social butterfly. He possesses a genius-level EQ, making him instantly likable and a massive hit with the ladies—though his disorganization and inability to say no to a good time recently backfired, leaving him an ex-girlfriend turned nightmare stalker.

Brilliant, adaptable, and a victim of vanity, Fred holds a degree in chemical engineering. However, after AI took his corporate job, he decided to pivot to his childhood dream of launching his own ghost exterminating business. This unconventional career move finally allows him to monetize a deep, lifelong passion for the paranormal.

[Skills: Superb comedic timing. Strong improvisation skills are a major asset. Fred needs to feel grounded, quick on his feet, and effortlessly witty. Open to any ethnicity.]

 

**KENNY**** **Lead (30/male) Kenny is a laid-back, jack-of-all-trades with a brilliant mechanical mind and endless blue-collar connections. He’s a fisherman by trade, but with the local fishing market collapsing, he’s had to pivot to a brand-new venture: ghost exterminating.

Kenny loves a cold beer (frequently enjoyed on the job), finding clever workarounds to hard labor (which others might call laziness), and pulling a good prank. He’s a natural mentor to Delmer, but often clashes with Justin’s academic methods. He’s comfortable in his own skin, rough around the edges, and fiercely loyal.

[Skills: Excellent Physical Comedy & Distinct Character Work: We need an actor who can bring a strong, specific physical presence and comedic timing to the screen. Strong improv skills are a major asset to capture his quick-witted, easygoing banter. A natural beer belly or a burly, blue-collar physique is a huge plus. Open to any ethnicity.] 

 

**JUSTIN**** **Lead (30s/male) A brilliant but tightly wound IT whiz who walked away from tech to chase a childhood dream with his two half-brothers of opening a ghost-hunting startup. With a math PhD and software background, Justin is a true polymath, a Shakespeare nut, and a sarcastic history buff who treats life as a quest to expand his brainpower. What he has in academic genius, he completely lacks in street smarts. He’s thrilled to finally be his own boss (sort of) and step into a new chapter of personal freedom. 

[Skills: Comedic delivery. Ability to improvise is an asset. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**DELMER**** **Co-Lead (18/male) Delmer is a friendly, sweet, genuine, and wide-eyed Hutterite runaway standing on the edge of a massive new world. Built with a solid, farm-raised physicality but carrying a deep, untouched innocence, he has spent his entire life in a strict communal society. Now, he is chasing a burning yearning to experience everything he’s never seen: skyscrapers piercing the clouds, bustling shopping malls, roaring sports cars, helicopters, the vast ocean and the electric pulse of big-city nightclubs.

This role is a powerhouse opportunity for an actor to portray a profound coming-of-age journey. We are looking for someone who can beautifully balance a strong physical presence with an endearing, vulnerable naivety as Delmer steps into his chaotic, exciting next chapter. [Actor must be 18+. Preference for Caucasian ethnicity]

 

**LILY**** **Co-Lead (30/female) Lily is cute, witty, and fiercely independent. After walking away from a cushy corporate ladder and a highly judgmental family, she traded her high heels for work boots to chase her dream: running her own hobby farm.

She’s earnest, deeply down-to-earth, and entirely back-to-nature—but passion doesn't pay the tuition for her agricultural courses. Enter Johnson Paranormal. To fund her late-night studying, she’s taken a gig as the agency's newest secretary. Balancing spreadsheets, ghost sightings, and goat feed, Lily is a grounded force in a chaotic, supernatural world. [Preference for Chinese/East Asian ethnicity]

 

**Ms. GUNDERSON** (80/female) She’s your friendly neighborhood grandma. She’s sweet, independent, slightly oblivious, devoted to her baking and prized cactus, and isn't afraid to unwind with a THC gummy. But her cozy world is turned upside down by an overwhelming ghost presence that's taking over her home.

[We are looking for an actress who can balance warmth and genuine vulnerability, as she faces the supernatural and keeps an embarrassing secret. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**TONY**** **(40s/male) Tony is the ultimate contradiction: a chill, uber-organized, and ruthlessly violent drug importer who genuinely believes in giving back to his community. When he isn't managing high-stakes international logistics or handling business with cold precision, he’s passionately funding local charities and cheering on neighborhood sports teams. He runs his empire like a Fortune 500 company, but his meticulously ordered life has just been thrown into complete chaos.

An annoying, chaotic ghost has moved into his estate, wreaking absolute havoc on his sanity and his bottom line. Tony is a man used to eliminating his problems—but how do you eliminate something you can’t kill?

[Seeking an actor who can balance a grounded, dangerous intensity with a relaxed, dry charm. Open to any ethnicity]

 

**How to Apply**

Please submit your headshot, resume, and demo reel (if available) to:
**Johnsonparanormalshow@gmail.com**

*Please include the character name you are submitting for in the email subject line (e.g., "Submission: FRED - [Your Name]").*

Hello everyone! 🎬
My name is Alex, I’m 26 years old and based in Austria.

Acting has always been a dream of mine, and I’m now ready to finally pursue it seriously. 
I’m looking to connect with actors, filmmakers, casting professionals and anyone working on interesting projects.

I currently work at a five ⭐️ hotel in Salzburg and previously worked in the automotive industry.

I speak Romanian, German and English, and I’m open to film, TV, commercials, short films or other acting opportunities.

My long-term dream is to work internationally, especially one day in California🇺🇸

If you’re working on a project and think I could be a fit, feel free to reach out.🎥

**Kleinwüchsige Darstellerin gesucht für „Getting In", Kunsthalle Wien**

 

Honorar: EUR 700,- (Werkvertrag, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung)

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

 

„Getting In" ist ein neues Lustspiel des kanadischen Regisseurs Harkeerat Mangat für eine Darstellerin. Es erzählt die Geschichte von Maria, die von der Pflege ihrer Mutter nach Hause zurückkehrt und feststellt, dass der Zugangscode zu ihrem Wohnhaus geändert wurde. Ausgesperrt muss sie ihre exzentrischen Nachbar*innen davon überzeugen, sie hereinzulassen. Premiere am 17. November 2026 um 19:00 Uhr in der Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz.

 

Alle Details: https://kunsthallewien.at/veranstaltung/performance-harkeerat-mangat-getting-in

**Die Rolle: Maria**

 

Wir suchen eine kleinwüchsige Frau, ca. 100 bis 150 cm, ca. 35 bis 65 Jahre, für die Rolle der Maria, die einzige Live-Rolle des Stücks.

 

Das Bühnenbild ist ein Modell-Wohnhaus von drei Metern Höhe, und die Bewohner*innen, die Maria zu überzeugen versucht, sind sehr klein. Die Dimensionen des Stücks funktionieren nur mit einer kleinwüchsigen Darstellerin.

 

Marias Sprache ist für das Publikum nicht verständlich. Der Text muss daher nicht auswendig gelernt werden. Die Bewegungsabläufe müssen einstudiert werden, es gibt darin aber Raum für Improvisation.

 

Da eine erfundene Sprache immer nach jener Sprache klingt, aus der sie kommt, suchen wir jemanden, der österreichisches Deutsch als Muttersprache oder auf muttersprachlichem Niveau spricht. Das Kauderwelsch soll österreichisch klingen.

 

Schauspielerfahrung ist willkommen, aber keine Voraussetzung. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen auf jedem Erfahrungsstand, auch von Personen, die noch nie auf einer Bühne gestanden sind.

 

**Zeitplan**

 

Bewerbungsfrist: 23. Oktober 2026, 23:59 Uhr

Vorsprechen: Woche ab 26. Oktober 2026, via Zoom

Erste Probe: Wochenende 30. Oktober bis 1. November 2026, vor Ort

Zweite Probe: Woche ab 9. November 2026

Endprobe auf der Bühne: 17. November 2026, Kunsthalle Wien Karlsplatz

Aufführung: 17. November 2026, 19:00 Uhr

 

Stundenausmaß: drei Proben à maximal vier Stunden sowie die Aufführung, gesamt ca. 14 Stunden.

** **

**Engagement und Honorar**

 

EUR 700,- gesamt auf Werkvertragsbasis, inklusive aller Proben und der Aufführung. Das Honorar orientiert sich an der Honoraruntergrenze der IG Freie Theaterarbeit. Auftraggeber: Harkeerat Mangat.

 

**Bewerbung**

 

Bitte schick bis 23. Oktober 2026 eine E-Mail an casting@harkeeratmangat.com mit:

 

1. Einem Foto von dir. Ein Handyfoto genügt völlig, es muss kein professionelles Foto sein.

2. Deinem Namen, Alter und deiner Körpergröße.

3. Ob du schon einmal gespielt hast, und wenn ja, kurz was. „Keine Erfahrung" ist eine völlig gute Antwort.

4. Ob du österreichisches Deutsch sprichst und ob es deine Alltagssprache ist.

 

Mehr braucht es nicht. Kein Lebenslauf, kein Showreel und kein Motivationsschreiben.

 

**Über den Künstler **

 

Harkeerat Mangat (geb. 1990 in Vancouver) ist kanadischer Filmemacher und Theaterregisseur und lebt in Wien. Sein Film „Fürstenplatz" und sein großangelegtes Theaterprojekt „Sommer-Kultur-Fest" wurden mit dem Vordemberge-Gildewart-Preis ausgezeichnet. Einzelausstellungen hatte er im Bonner Kunstverein, in der Stiftung Museum Insel Hombroich und im kjubh Kunstverein; Performances zeigte er im Kunstverein Gartenhaus, Wien, und in der Zweigstelle Capitain, Neapel.

 

Er entwirft Szenarien, innerhalb derer die Darsteller*innen frei improvisieren, und arbeitet sowohl mit professionellen als auch mit nicht-professionellen Schauspieler*innen.

 

KONTAKT

 

Harkeerat Mangat

casting@harkeeratmangat.com

CASTING - Deux acteur.ices pour un court-métrage expérimental
Bonjour à toutes et à tous,

Nous recherchons deux acteur.ices âgé.es de 20 à 30 ans pour une scène de baiser dans le cadre d’un court métrage expérimental indépendant.

La scène : 
Le film se compose d’une série de plans nocturnes tournés en pleine ville. La scène du baiser comprend deux plans en extérieur, de nuit, filmés à distance des personnages, sans gros plans.

Durée du tournage : 2 heures maximum
Rémunération : 50 € par personne
Lieu : région parisienne 

Aucun prérequis de genre, de taille ou d’origine ethnique. Les candidatures de couples ou de personnes qui se connaissent déjà sont les bienvenues, sans que cela soit obligatoire. 

Pour candidater : envoyez un mail à webehem@gmail.com, accompagné de votre book et/ou bande démo si vous en avez.

N’hésitez pas à partager cette annonce autour de vous !

Merci d’avance pour vos candidatures et vos partages.

*****CASTING CALL FOR WOMEN***** (DENVER, Colorado)

We are casting for a LIVE Women's Wrestling Show ->

ABOUT THE SHOW - Comedy and character focused, and yes, with wrestling (staged).  Picture a modern, local version of GLOW. Acting ability is key. The physical stuff can be taught.

No wrestling or stunt experience? No problem! We are extremely mindful of comfort and safety! I have an extensive background in martial arts and everything is scripted and rehearsed. 

HOW TO AUDITION 

1. Send headshots/resume to RosieShannonComedy (at ) gmail

2. Send a video reel of yourself (see note below*). One minute maximum please.

*****If you have a character idea or concept, AWESOME, send it! 

If not, totally fine. If you need an idea for your audition monologue, watch some episodes of GLOW and just pick a monologue as your audition piece. We're all GLOW fans around here!

TIMELINE - Goal is to have a core cast by the end of 2026. Training, rehearsals, etc. won't start until 2027. So there's no rush on sending your reels. Please make it count and send us your best work.

This is for Youtube. Every performer is paid for LIVE performances, but the B rolls/interviews/character work is unpaid. 

Lastly, PLEASE DO NOT message me via Facebook. Please follow the instructions. Thank you :)

Poszukujemy Statystów w wieku 18-70 lat (kobiety i mężczyzn) z Kielc lub okolic na plan zdjęciowy do spotu reklamowego dla znanej sieci restauracji w Kielcach w dniach 3.11, lub 4.11 (wtorek lub środa).

1. Zdjęcia w plenerze. Nagrania późnym popołudniem do nocy.

2. Wynagrodzenie za 1 dzień zdjęciowy: 150 zł netto (płatne w ciągu 1 dnia po planie zdjęciowym — BLIK na numer telefonu/konto bankowe).

W razie zainteresowania i dostępności w dniach 3.11 lub 4.11 prosimy o wysłanie zgłoszenia, podając następujące informację:

1. Imię i nazwisko

2. Rok urodzenia

3. Miasto zamieszkania

4. Telefon kontaktowy

5. Adres e-mail

6. Wzrost

7. Czy jest Pan/Pani dostępna/y w terminie 3.11-4.11?

8. Link do swojego profilu na Facebook/Instagram

9. Minimum jedno zdjęcie

Kontakt: rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl

W temacie wiadomości prosimy napisać: Plan zdjęciowy Kielce

Wysłanie zgłoszenie jest jednoznaczne z wyrażeniem zgody na przetwarzanie danych osobowych w celu udziału w planie zdjęciowym zgodnie z Rozporządzeniem Parlamentu Europejskiego i Rady (UE) 2016/679 z dnia 27 kwietnia 2016 r. w sprawie ochrony osób fizycznych w związku z przetwarzaniem danych osobowych i w sprawie swobodnego przepływu takich danych oraz uchylenia dyrektywy 95/46/WE (ogólne rozporządzenie o ochronie danych). Administratorem Twoich danych osobowych pozyskanych w procesie rekrutacyjnym jest Agencja Artystyczna INFERNAL. Podanie danych jest dobrowolne, w każdej chwili przysługuje Ci prawo do wglądu do danych, ich poprawiania lub usunięcia. Kontakt do administratora rekrutacja@agencjainfernal.pl.

**ACTORS & PERFORMERS — FLEXIBLE PART-TIME JOB!**

**Hourly pay (+bonuses) | West Los Angeles | Flexible Weekday Hours**

Love meeting new people? Great at memorizing scripts, delivering a message naturally, and thinking on your feet?

We're a physician-led medical clinic looking for an outgoing, confident **Community Outreach/ Physician Liaison **

**What you'll do:**
* Learn and deliver short, conversational scripts introducing our clinic.
* Visit local physician offices and meet new people every day.
* Build relationships and make a great first impression.
* Think on your feet, handle different personalities, and adapt to each conversation.
* Listen to feedback and help us improve the patient referral experience.

**You're a great fit if you:**
* Love talking to people and aren't afraid to approach strangers.
* Can memorize a script and deliver it naturally and convincingly.
* Are charismatic, personable, and a great listener.
* Are comfortable with rejection and can stay positive.
* Have a reliable car and can work weekday hours.

Great opportunity for actors, performers, theater students, and anyone who enjoys connecting with people.

Interested? Email us at hello@infinitywellnessmd.com

We're PickledFish, an emerging Edinburgh-based narrative production company. We're casting two leads for a stylised, Matrix-inspired narrative spec commercial. It's a self-funded spec project. It's fully practical, shot on the Alexa Mini LF in a professional London studio (Zone 2) with a full professional crew.

See our work: https://pickledfish.tv

After a big night out, Leo collapses on his couch and wakes in an endless white room. A mysterious suited figure offers him a choice: painkillers and a wasted day, or something better.

📅 Shoot: 14–15 Nov, London

—

LEO (lead, male, playing age 21–35)

💷 £50/day · 2 shoot days

Leo is a committed raver: still dancing when he's running on empty, then waking up bright, sharp and himself again. The role has no dialogue, so it's all physicality and expression. It goes from exhausted and spaced-out, to confused and wide-eyed in the white room, to warm, easy and laughing the next morning.

We're looking for someone who:

- is comfortable dancing on camera

- can tell a story with their body and face, without lines

- is available both days

—

SUITED FIGURE (lead, any gender, any ethnicity, playing age 30–65)

💷 £85/day · 1 shoot day

The Suited Figure is a calm, commanding and slightly unnerving guide who exists in "the moment just before you fall asleep." Think of a hypnotic mentor figure: measured, precise, a little theatrical, with total control of the room. They wear a dark suit, green tie and rimless glasses, which we provide. A homage to a certain iconic character.

We're looking for someone with:

- a strong voice and mesmerising delivery, since this role carries all of the dialogue

- stillness and presence on screen

- availability for one day, within 14–15 Nov (we'll confirm the date once you're cast)

—

💷 Paid day rates as above, plus food on set, travel covered, an IMDb-style credit and a high-quality copy of the finished film for your reel.

Usage: this is a spec commercial. It'll be used on PickledFish's portfolio, online channels and in festival submissions.

—

🎥 HOW TO APPLY

Email your self-tape link, headshot and CV to hello@pickledfish.tv with the role name in the subject line, by Wed 28 Oct. Applications by email only, please. We can't take submissions via DM or comments.

LEO: walk to a chair, slump into it exhausted and fall asleep. Then wake up, open your hand, and smile at what you find. A 10–20 second dance clip is a bonus.

SUITED FIGURE: record a self-tape of these sides:

"This... is the moment just before you fall asleep. You have a choice to make. Maybe your head hurts a little bit less, but you still wake up sluggish and dazed, stuck in bed as the day marches on. Remember, the choice is yours, yours, yours, yours, yours, yours..."

Thank you!

items.text:
URGENT CASTING CALL for Production 2 of The Black Widows Pilot
3-day film shoot on the 15th-17th November 2026 in Coventry/Rugby

We have a micro budget so will provide lunch and cover travel expenses

 

Our current cast includes makeup-artists, director of photography, 1st assistant director and script supervisor alongside our cast of actors and actresses.

 

We have the main cast recruited but have some additional exciting roles available

 

We are searching for some talented actresses and actors to bring some of these compelling characters to life on our BLACK WIDOWS production. 

Set against a decade of betrayal, ambition, and bloody survival, Black Widows follows a fierce all-female crew operating in the shadows of a massive criminal empire.

The Character Profiles are below;

1. CEE (Late Teens/ Early Twenties) (2 scenes (1 day) This is an LGBT role

* Ethnicity & Look: Mixed Race, Latino or ethnically ambiguous 

* The Character: A gifted athlete and musician who plays Toya’s love interest. Cee possesses strong morals, fierce internal strength, and a rare, unyielding conscience forged by her unique background and upbringing. 

* Vibe: Captivating, athletic, soulful, and morally grounded amidst the chaos.

2. KIDADA’S FRIEND ALYSSA (Age Flexible / Adult) (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Slender White female with curly hair.

* The Character: A gritty, street-level drug addict who features briefly in the storyline. Desperate and unpredictable, she ultimately squats in Kidada’s home while Kidada is away in rehab. 

* Vibe: Raw, vulnerable, authentic, and emotionally charged.

3. VIVIAN (One scene – Half a day)

* Demographic: Black or Mixed-Race Woman, 50s to Early 60s.

* The Role: Vivian is a hardened, razor-sharp, and deeply complex woman. A recovering alcoholic, she holds the heaviest title in the room: she is the mother of Brenda James, the notorious, ruthless "mother of the underworld." 

* The Vibe: Vivian is hateful, resentful, brilliant, and fiercely intelligent. She is a multi-layered powerhouse who commands every single scene she is in. If you love playing complex, unapologetic characters with dark depths and sharp edges, Vivian is the role for you.

4. BEN (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 30s Male.

* The Character: A low level street runner who is a known criminal

5. MARCUS (One scene 1-2 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race. 40s-50s Male.

* The Character: A local unstable sleazeball who hustles and does whatever it takes to get on in life

6. Claire (One scene 2-3 hours)

* Ethnicity & Look: Any race (Age flexible female)

* The Character: A kind and friendly support worker who works at the drug and substance misuse clinic

EXTRA’s roles are available in addition to the above roles 

BENEFITS OF BEING PART OF THE PRODUCTION

* Official IMDb Credit: Boost your industry profile with a major television credit.

* CV & Acting Portfolio Development: Work alongside top-tier talent and crew, capturing stellar footage and high-end broadcast-quality material for your showreel post the production’s release.

* This production comes with a potential opportunity to reprise your role in a massive, upcoming 14-part TV series extension subject to investment funding! 

Please DM me for further details and to apply for the roles.

items.text:
🎬 CASTING CALL – CHRISTMAS SHORT FILM
We’re looking for a male actor aged 50–60 for our upcoming student short film!

Project: Christmas-themed short film

Location: Rugby, Warwickshire, UK

Filming date: 1st November 2026

Fee: £100 (low-budget student production)

About the film:

A heartwarming Christmas story about nostalgia. 

The story follows Leonard, a man spending Christmas alone, who discovers an old toy robot in his shed. As the forgotten toy unexpectedly comes to life, a little Christmas magic begins to unfold.

Character – LEONARD (Male, 50–60)

A quiet, slightly lonely man with a sentimental side. The role involves expressing emotions through actions and facial expressions, with no dialogue.

This is a student VFX project, and we’re a small team working to bring this Christmas story to life!

As this is a student production, we have a limited budget, but we’re able to offer £100 for the role.

If you’re interested or would like to know more, please comment below or send me a private message!

Thank you! 🎄

items.text:
⚔️ CASTING CALL: SOLDIERS WANTED
DEFIANCE recreates the December 28, 1835 ambush of Major Dade's column, the battle that sparked the Second Seminole War. We're filming on the historic ground where it happened.

We're looking for: Men, ages 20-35, to play U.S. Army infantry and artillery in Dade's column. Athletic, driven, and ready for action. You'll bring the grit and intensity of 1830s warfare to the screen.

Pay: Paid, non-union

Filming:

Jan 29-31, 2027: Fort King (Ocala)

Feb 1-2: Fort Foster (Thonotosassa)

Feb 3-13: Boyd Hill Nature Preserve (St. Petersburg)

Ready to step onto the battlefield? Email Karolina at 3ratsentertainment@gmail.com with your headshot, height/sizes, resume, and contact info.

Tag a friend and share this post. We need soldiers!

3 Rats Entertainment LLC & Avail Entertainment LLC

This headshot picture was the first headshot I sent in for my profile to be in movies and television last year...
And a few days later, I received an email to be booked for Landman ... 
I confirmed the booking and showed up to set...  I did not know what to do but they told me of course...
And since then I have been in " The Trail of Tears: The Hyme ", " Brothers ", "Hot Year", and "Copperhead"...
And believe me, I will be in other movies and television in the future...
A few people have reached out to me for photo shoots as well but I would love to do something with fashion... Native American fashion wear cloths...
But anyhow this picture is the picture that started me in the film industry...

VANCOUVER CASTING CALL — TWO FEMALE ROLES
We’re seeking two performers who can portray teenage girls, ages 13–19, for an independent short film exploring social issues affecting women. Adults who can convincingly play teens are welcome to apply.

Role 1: Open to all ethnicities

Role 2: Seeking an Indigenous performer

We’re looking for a natural presence and emotional depth. No acting experience or demo reel is required. Please send a short, makeup-free video introducing yourself.

Location: Vancouver

Filming: Two days in early November

Compensation: Unpaid portfolio project. Meals provided on both days.

The film is led by a female director, with a crew of Vancouver Film School graduates currently working in the industry. The director’s previous short received selections and awards across four film festivals in London and the United States. We plan to submit this film to more than 50 festivals.

Please send your introduction video and availability to hiayj23@gmail.com.

Thank you for your interest. Sharing this casting call is appreciated.

Do reklamy znanego banku szukamy:

1. EPIZOD — ROLA MÓWIONA: KELNERKA, 25–35 lat. 
Stawka: 5500-7000 zł.

Role niemówione (Stawka: 2500-4000 zł):

2. KOBIETA — 18–25 lat; typ modelki beauty. Musi mieć przekłute uszy.

3. MĘŻCZYZNA — 20–25 lat; ciekawa, współczesna twarz.

4. ELEGANCKA KOBIETA: dojrzała kobieta z klasą, w wieku około 40–45 lat.

5. MĘŻCZYZNA — szczupły, w wieku 35–40 lat, który będzie pływał w basenie na materacu w kształcie ananasa. 

*scena będzie częściowo generowana przy użyciu AI, jednak casting jest prowadzony w celu wykorzystania wizerunku wybranej osoby.

Warszawa.
27.10 - termin nadsyłania zgłoszeń.
16.11 (poniedziałek) — PRZYMIARKI.
20 i/lub 21.11 — ZDJĘCIA.

Søges: Kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til at mime med kort musikvideo/ reel 🎬✨
I forbindelse med udgivelsen af mit debutalbum A Woman’s Heart i november, søger jeg kvinder i alle aldre i hele landet til et et kort klip til en reel!

Hvad går det ud på?

Du skal blot filme en kort selfie-video (tæt på ansigtet), hvor du mimer med på omkvædet (musikken bliver lagt på bagefter) – enten med et stort smil, et fjollet udtryk eller bare ren god energi. Sangen handler nemlig om at slippe sig fri som kvinde, og omkvædet er supernemt at lære! 

Tanken er mange korte klip fra mange forskellige kvinder, så man ser dig højst sandsynligt kun i et par sekunder. ☺️

Det praktiske:

• Du filmer det selv derhjemme - burde ikke tage mere end 15 min. 

• Honorar: Der er et lille symbolsk honorar for din tid, da det også er en lille opgave og min økonomi ikke er så stor endnu. 

Hvis det lyder som noget for dig, så send mig en besked - så sender jeg sangen og mere info! ☺️

topComments.text: Helle Dahl det kan du også. 😊🤩

Er du god til at lyve, fortælle historier og tage lidt pis på andre? Så søger vi dig!

Vi er Chris & Jacob, og vi mangler 3 personer (18+) til en sjov YouTube-video, vi optager i morgen!

Konceptet:

Vi samler 5 deltagere, som hver især har én vild, sjov eller usædvanlig historie fra deres liv.

Vi skal igennem 5 runder, hvor alle deltagere fortæller deres version af den samme historie. Men kun én fortæller sandheden, mens de andre 4 skal forsøge at lyve sig igennem!

Vores opgave er at afhøre jer og finde ud af, hvem der faktisk har oplevet historien.

Du behøver ikke være skuespiller eller verdensmester i at lyve! I får historiernes overskrifter på forhånd, så I kan forberede jer.

Vi søger bare nogle friske, udadvendte personer med god humor, som har lyst til at være med på kamera!

18+

items.text:
Is W Talent NYC $1500 fee a red flag?
Any experiences with W Talent NYC? We attended a kids casting cast last weekend & got an email saying only 20% of the attendees were selected and we are among the 20%. 

But to get onboarded they are asking around 1500$ ( photoshoot 650$ , website postings 500$ and the rest to create a composite card!! ) 

Any suggestions ? Is this even legit? Did anyone actually get placed with this agency? 

Appreciate any responses. TIA

topComments.text:
They aren’t an agency. They are a scam. What you have described is the classic scammer playbook: 
-“20% are chosen”. no, even if they were an agency you are choosing THEM as your new employee not the other way around). 
-Legit agencies don’t sell photos, not to mention the prices are outrageous. 
-never ever pay to sign with an agency  
-you didn’t go to a casting call or an audition because those are, by legal definition, job interviews. In this case there is no job on the table. You went to a sales pitch. 

It doesn’t mean your child isn’t beautiful or talented. Just means you were introduced to a scammer (and consider where you heard about them—they are likely scammers too). 

Walk away, mama! I can tell your spidey senses are tingling— trust them!
This is the definition of "red flags"! They contact everyone and their only goal is to separate you from your money.  This is NOT how a legitimate agency works.

CASTING CALL for 'Bruiser', a short student boxing film. (LONDON)

A career boxer has to make an important decision with his loyal promoter, which will either preserve or destroy his legacy.

Casting for four characters in Bruiser, a short boxing film which will deal with men's mental health, as well as parody mainstream boxing. The boxer will be paid to lose, but will he accept the price for ending his boxing career?

The roles we're looking for are:

George Dutch. (30-40)

A man who has boxed his whole life, he is in his 30s and still in shape.

Dave Murphy. (50-60)

Dave is George's manager and has managed George's career since it began. Dave is in his 50s.

Denise Dutch. (30-40)

A woman who has supported George throughout his life, since they married in their 20s. Denise is in her 30s.

The Youtuber. (20-30)

The Youtuber is a more unserious role, he is in his 20s and does not look like a boxer, but is still in shape.

Shoot dates and locations to be determined (TBD) but will be based around London, with one possible location being in essex.

Specific dates undecided, but will likely be rehearsing in December of this year, and shooting in January of next year.

Contact me at contact.riojones@gmail.com!

(Please send a photo of yourself, as well as your name, your age, and which role you want)

**CASTING CALL: AUDITIONS OPEN** 

**Project Title:** ***The Life That I Want ***

**Shoot Dates:** Early December

**Rehearsals:** 2–3 days in late November

**Produced by: **Dimas Films 

**Location:** Denver, CO 

**Non-Union / Unpaid (Copy, Credit, and Meals Provided)**
**ABOUT THE PROJECT**

Leaving his home country to chase his Hollywood dream, Javier is paralyzed by a stage fright that keeps him trapped behind self-imposed walls. When an unexpected opportunity forces him into the spotlight, his journey intersects with Hayley, Kerlen, and Rumie—others facing their own internal barriers. Bound by a shared passion and a powerful musical centerpiece, they unite through movement and song to shatter their fears and embrace the true heart of their craft.

*Note: This is a dance- and movement-focused short film. All musical numbers will be ****lip-synced****—no live vocal performance or singing required!*
**CHARACTER BREAKDOWNS**
**1. HAYLEY**
* **Gender/Age:** Female, 18–25 (Any Ethnicity)
* **Description:** Expressive, intensely passionate, yet guarded. Hayley carries her own deep-seated internal barriers that hold her back from unleashing her full potential. She needs strong emotional depth and dynamic dance ability to convey her character's internal journey through movement.
**2. KERLEN**
* **Gender/Age:** Any Gender, 40+ (Any Ethnicity)
* **Description:** Resilient, determined, and deeply passionate, Kerlen acts as a crucial pillar in the ensemble—yet she is privately consumed by self-doubt. Struggling with the fear that time is running out, she constantly worries that she is too old to pursue her artistic dreams or that she will be judged by her peers and industry standards. Through her connection with Javier and the group, Kerlen learns to break free from these self-imposed limitations, proving that passion and artistry have no age limit. Strong stage presence and expressive physical storytelling are essential.
**3. RUMIE**
* **Gender/Age: **male, 18–25 (Any Ethnicity)
* **Description:** Vibrant, perceptive, and highly empathetic, yet fighting a quiet battle against anxiety. Rumie’s energy helps spark connection within the group. Looking for an actor/dancer with high emotional range and fluid movement skills.
**FEATURED DANCERS & ENSEMBLE**
* **Ages:** 18 to 45+ (All Genders, All Ethnicities)
* **Description:** We are seeking versatile dancers, Extras, and performers of all backgrounds and body types who want to participate in sharing this beautiful story. Performers should be comfortable with contemporary, jazz, or storytelling-focused choreography and able to express strong emotion through movement.
**SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS**

To be considered, please submit to **dimasfilmsinfo@gmail.com **the following:
1. **Headshot & Resume** (or current photos and relevant performance/dance background).
2. **Video Submission:** A **30s dance choreography video** demonstrating your movement style, rhythm, and emotional expression. (Can be self-choreographed or a showcase of past work). **( Optional )**
3. **Availability:** Confirmation that you are available for late November rehearsals and early December filming days in the Denver area.

* **Description:** Resilient, determined, and deeply passionate, Kerlen acts as a crucial pillar in the ensemble—yet she is privately consumed by self-doubt. Struggling with the fear that time is running out, she constantly worries that she is too old to pursue her artistic dreams or that she will be judged by her peers and industry standards. Through her connection with Javier and the group, Kerlen learns to break free from these self-imposed limitations, proving that passion and artistry have no age limit. Strong stage presence and expressive physical storytelling are essential.
**3. RUMIE**
* **Gender/Age: **male, 18–25 (Any Ethnicity)
* **Description:** Vibrant, perceptive, and highly empathetic, yet fighting a quiet battle against anxiety. Rumie’s energy helps spark connection within the group. Looking for an actor/dancer with high emotional range and fluid movement skills.
**FEATURED DANCERS & ENSEMBLE**
* **Ages:** 18 to 45+ (All Genders, All Ethnicities)
* **Description:** We are seeking versatile dancers, Extras, and performers of all backgrounds and body types who want to participate in sharing this beautiful story. Performers should be comfortable with contemporary, jazz, or storytelling-focused choreography and able to express strong emotion through movement.
**SUBMISSION REQUIREMENTS**

To be considered, please submit to **dimasfilmsinfo@gmail.com **the following:
1. **Headshot & Resume** (or current photos and relevant performance/dance background).
2. **Video Submission:** A **30s dance choreography video** demonstrating your movement style, rhythm, and emotional expression. (Can be self-choreographed or a showcase of past work). **( Optional )**
3. **Availability:** Confirmation that you are available for late November rehearsals and early December filming days in the Denver area.
